caption: A car with a booming stereo pulls up at a light, and the fuzzy dice hanging from its rear-view mirror jiggle with the bass.

sa.check: Fuzzy dice hang from a car's rear-view mirror.
The car pulls up and stops at a traffic light.
The jiggle is a rapid twitch rather than a slow pendulum swing.
The dice are still jiggling after the car has stopped.

pc.expect: The dice hang from their string and twitch about the hanging point with the string taut above them.
pc.fail: The dice rise with the string going slack; or move sideways as a pair while the string above them stays perfectly still and straight; or float away from the mirror.

pc.expect: Other loose light things in the cabin twitch at the same moments as the dice.
pc.fail: An air freshener, charm or paper hangs dead still while the dice twitch hard; or it twitches while the dice hang still; or the two move at different moments.
pc.precondition: Another loose light object hangs or lies in the cabin.

pc.expect: As the car slows, the dice swing toward the windscreen and then back.
pc.fail: The dice swing toward the rear as the car brakes; or stay rigidly vertical as the scene outside comes to a halt; or swing sideways only.
pc.precondition: The car's slowing is visible through the windows.

pc.expect: The dice hang below the mirror on their string and return to hanging straight down after each swing.
pc.fail: The dice rest tilted off vertical with a taut string and nothing touching them; or rise above the mirror; or the string arcs upward.

pc.expect: The dice keep their number; one mirror; nothing passes through the windscreen.
pc.fail: An extra die appears; or a die vanishes; or the dice pass through the windscreen or mirror; or the dice merge into one.

pc.expect: The dice's colour and pips, the mirror and the dashboard stay the same.
pc.fail: The dice change colour or their pips change; or the mirror moves on its own; or the dashboard changes.

note: The car and the stereo are self-driven; the dice swinging forward as the car brakes is inertia, not a violation.
